title: Host P104 frame 1 and intersect its new monomials with the recorded forty.
body:
<!-- CURSOR_AGENT_PR_BODY_BEGIN -->
## Change and mathematical scope

Hosts frame 1 of the open #7014 104-by-13 witness as a product of root-line labels, charges every new monomial of that word, and intersects those monomials with the 40 recorded for frame 0 by #7031. No new κ. The selected record stays `781451/250000000`.

Frame 1 is the odd-graph clique `13, 26, 131, 148, 262, 273, 392, 415`. The only letters identically 1 on these eight lines are the eight frame letters. Their linear parts are the eight vectors of one affine hyperplane in a 4-dimensional space. A subset hosts the row exactly when those vectors span the space, so there are 56 hosting words of length 4 and every subset of length 5, 6, 7, or 8, and none shorter. All 149 hosting products equal

```text
(1 + x1 + x3)(1 + x0 + x1 + x4)(1 + x1 + x2 + x5 + x6)(1 + x0 + x1 + x5 + x7).
```

The lexicographically first word uses ports `13, 26, 131, 262`. The expansion has 120 square-free monomials. Eight degree-1 monomials and the constant are the degree-at-most-1 part. The other **111** have degrees 2, 3, and 4 (counts 27, 47, 37).

Of those 111, **31** lie in the 40 monomials recorded for frame 0. The additional bill, once those 40 are paid, is the other **80**. Nine recorded monomials are absent from frame 1. The joint degree-at-least-2 support of the two words has 120 monomials. Fifty-one of the 111 contain `x3`; the recorded polynomial does not use `x3`, so all 51 sit in the additional 80. The pairing rank of the 8-by-8 all-ones support is 1 and is not added.

The hosting classification and the length count are written proofs. The chart identity, the admissible-letter test, the 255 subset products, and the boolean expansion (cross-checked by the Möbius transform of the 16-point flat) are exhaustive finite censuses. This is not a heuristic. It is not a lower bound for sums of letters, another chart, or a non-product circuit. It is not a selected-invoice histogram, so it does not beat the selected profile. Frames 2 through 12 are not expanded. The frame-0 census is not rerun; the recorded 40 are the published closed form, locked by ANF hash `26803d29aa3141a357da4aa551195fe6378d3f2e1cba0c4291a4dedbce6ded2a`.

## Task and overlap

Base: `17469fff78c22941280f04d39dc5a1faee09c840`. Task card `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, priority revision 8. Scope is **changed**: the card asks whether a decoder or coframe change improves the full signed moment; this package answers open question 1 of #7031, for frame 1 only. The intersection is a prerequisite for pricing two rows together. It is not a signed histogram and not a supplier admission.

Nearest overlap is #7031 (head `531ecca652dde63c6010cd6097cb55a994367ce7`) and its finding at discussion comment 19514167, which ask this question and do not answer it. #7014 (head `949c0ada285aae619468ae49317c8d9f4df130f7`) factors the window and does not host a row. A refreshed overlap search on 2026-11-10 (339 open PRs, 7013 discussion records, complete local note inventory at the base commit) returned only those items for this question. `data/frames.json` is the #7014 witness as vendored by #7031, hashed `c75915c18fc06ac19cc90fb9911209517c071862fdf401b998d5075efc0cda0d`. Ports and the E8 line map are the #6933 inputs pinned in `SOURCES.json`.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only. From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B research/p104-frame1-monomial-intersection/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/p104-frame1-monomial-intersection/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-frame1-monomial-intersection
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-frame1-monomial-intersection --check-source-history
```

Observed: `PASS_P104_FRAME1_INTERSECTION word=13,26,131,262 monomials=120 new=111 intersection=31 additional=80 joint=120 absent_from_frame1=9` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`. Source-history check passes at `e7271f9d709149590071f11a29dfe702d427b59a`. Failure controls delete one canonical letter, count the 14 length-4 misses, reject a rank-3 prefix, delete the constant monomial, and multiply by a non-frame letter.

Not run: the frame-0 product census, a sum-of-letters search, frames 2 through 12, the selected-supplier replay, `make frontier6030-verify`, and Lean.

## Credit

Frame partition: unpaidmoon, PR #7014. Frame-0 hosting and the recorded forty: PR #7031. Ports and the odd-graph window: PR #6933. Label pairing: the inherited simple-root chart. Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. New work is Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Host frame 2 the same way and intersect its degree-at-least-2 monomials with the joint 120-monomial support of frames 0 and 1. The two-row union is not yet a thirteen-row bill.
2. Can one circuit charge each of the 31 shared monomials once and still host both rows? The intersection compares two separate expansions and does not exhibit a joint word.
